title: Solutions Architect- AI (CTC: 50K-80K Per Month)
description:
Solutions Architect – AI

**Company:**
Sapiogen AI Private Limited

**Department:**
Engineering & Technology

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**Work Mode:**
On-Site

**Location:**
Ahmedabad, Gujarat

**Experience:**
3–7 Years

**Compensation:**
₹50,000–₹80,000 per month

About Sapiogen AI

Sapiogen AI is an
**AI-first software engineering company**
building intelligent software products, AI-powered business solutions, scalable digital platforms, and modern enterprise systems.

We combine
**AI + human engineering expertise**
to help startups, enterprises, and technology-driven businesses design, build, modernize, and scale software faster.

Our focus spans
**AI/ML, Generative AI, Agentic AI, Cloud, Data Engineering, Automation, Digital Engineering, and Enterprise Software Development.**

About the Role

We are looking for a
**Solutions Architect – AI**
who can bridge the gap between
**business problems, AI capabilities, software architecture, and engineering execution**
.

You will work closely with clients, founders, business stakeholders, sales, and engineering teams to understand complex requirements and translate them into
**scalable, secure, commercially viable AI-powered solutions**
.

The ideal candidate is someone who can confidently sit in a client meeting, understand the business problem, design the technology solution, explain the architecture, estimate effort, and work with engineers to ensure successful implementation.

This is a highly strategic and hands-on role with significant exposure to
**AI consulting, solution design, pre-sales, architecture, and delivery.**

Key Responsibilities1. AI Solution Architecture

* Design end-to-end AI-powered solutions for startups, enterprises, and modern businesses.
* Architect solutions involving
  **Generative AI, LLMs, AI Agents, RAG, NLP, Computer Vision, Voice AI, Machine Learning, and intelligent automation**
  .
* Design scalable application, data, AI, API, integration, and cloud architectures.
* Select appropriate technologies, frameworks, models, APIs, databases, and infrastructure.
* Define architecture principles, technical standards, security considerations, and scalability strategies.
* Evaluate build-vs-buy decisions and third-party AI platforms.

2. Client Consulting & Discovery

* Participate in client discovery calls and technical workshops.
* Understand business objectives, pain points, existing technology environments, and desired outcomes.
* Convert business requirements into technical requirements and solution blueprints.
* Identify opportunities where AI, automation, modernization, or digital engineering can create measurable business value.
* Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

3. Pre-Sales & Solution Engineering

* Work closely with the
  **CEO, CRO, sales, and engineering teams**
  during the pre-sales lifecycle.
* Develop technical proposals, solution approaches, architecture diagrams, statements of work, and estimates.
* Conduct technical presentations, solution demonstrations, and proof-of-concepts.
* Support RFP/RFI responses and technical due diligence.
* Help define project scope, milestones, assumptions, dependencies, risks, and delivery approach.
* Participate in client presentations and technical negotiations when required.

4. AI & Technology Leadership

* Stay current with rapidly evolving AI technologies and engineering practices.
* Evaluate new LLMs, AI APIs, agentic frameworks, cloud AI services, developer tools, and automation platforms.
* Identify opportunities to improve engineering productivity using AI-assisted development.
* Establish reusable AI architecture patterns, accelerators, frameworks, and solution components.
* Guide engineering teams on implementing production-grade AI systems.

5. Architecture & Engineering Collaboration

* Collaborate with software engineers, AI/ML engineers, DevOps engineers, data engineers, and product teams.
* Review technical designs and architecture decisions.
* Ensure solutions are scalable, maintainable, secure, observable, and cost-efficient.
* Provide technical direction during implementation.
* Identify architectural risks and recommend corrective actions.
* Ensure alignment between proposed architecture and actual implementation.

6. Cloud & Infrastructure

Hands-on understanding of one or more major cloud platforms is expected:

* AWS
* Microsoft Azure
* Google Cloud Platform

You should understand:

* Cloud architecture
* Containers & Docker
* Kubernetes fundamentals
* Serverless architecture
* API gateways
* Databases
* Networking
* IAM & security
* CI/CD
* Monitoring & observability
* Cloud cost optimization

Required Technical SkillsAI / Generative AI

* Generative AI and LLM architectures
* Prompt engineering
* RAG architectures
* Vector databases
* AI agents / Agentic AI
* LLM APIs and model integration
* AI evaluation and monitoring
* AI security and responsible AI fundamentals
* Fine-tuning / model customization concepts
* Conversational AI and/or Voice AI is a plus

Software Engineering

Strong understanding of:

* Python and/or JavaScript/TypeScript
* REST APIs and API integrations
* Microservices
* Distributed systems
* Databases
* Event-driven architecture
* Authentication & authorization
* System design
* Software development lifecycle

Data

* SQL and NoSQL databases
* Data pipelines
* Data integration
* Data processing concepts
* Data architecture fundamentals

DevOps / Cloud

* AWS / Azure / GCP
* Docker
* CI/CD
* Git
* Kubernetes fundamentals
* Infrastructure and deployment architecture

What We Are Looking For

* 3–7 years of experience in
  **Solutions Architecture, Technical Architecture, Software Architecture, AI Engineering, or related roles**
  .
* Strong understanding of modern software architecture and system design.
* Practical understanding of AI/ML and Generative AI technologies.
* Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
* Strong client-facing and communication skills.
* Experience working with engineering teams and leading technical discussions.
* Experience creating architecture diagrams and technical documentation.
* Ability to estimate projects and contribute to proposals/SOWs.
* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
* Ability to work in a fast-moving startup environment.
* Strong ownership mentality and willingness to get hands-on when required.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience working with international clients, particularly US, UK, Canada, Australia, or UAE markets.
* Experience in an AI consulting, software engineering, digital transformation, or technology services company.
* Experience with enterprise architecture.
* Experience in pre-sales or solution consulting.
* Experience building AI/LLM proof-of-concepts.
* Experience with LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or similar AI ecosystems.
* Experience with AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Vertex AI, or equivalent platforms.
* Experience with Salesforce, SAP, Microsoft, or other enterprise ecosystems is a plus.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Success in this role will be measured by:

* Quality and feasibility of proposed solutions.
* Successful conversion of technical opportunities into projects.
* Client satisfaction and technical credibility.
* Accuracy of solution estimates and project scope.
* Quality of architecture documentation.
* Successful delivery of AI-powered solutions.
* Reusability of architecture patterns and accelerators.
* Reduction in solution/design turnaround time.
* Contribution to revenue through solution consulting and pre-sales.
* Adoption of modern AI-first engineering practices.

Why Join Sapiogen AI?

At Sapiogen AI, you won't simply be designing software architectures.

You will help define how
**AI-first software engineering is delivered to modern businesses.**

You will have the opportunity to:

* Work on real-world AI and enterprise transformation projects.
* Interact directly with international clients and business leaders.
* Work across AI, cloud, data, automation, and software engineering.
* Influence architecture and technology decisions from the early stages.
* Build reusable AI solution accelerators.
* Work closely with the founding team.
* Grow into senior leadership responsibilities as the company scales.

Career Growth

This role has a potential growth path toward:

**Solutions Architect → Senior Solutions Architect → Principal Architect → Head of Engineering / CTO**

depending on performance, leadership ability, technical depth, and contribution to Sapiogen AI's growth.

Our Ideal Candidate

You are someone who can take a problem like:

**"Our business has this problem. Can AI solve it?"**

and turn it into:

**Business Requirement → AI Strategy → Solution Architecture → Technology Selection → POC → Implementation → Production → Scale**

If you are passionate about
**AI, architecture, consulting, and building technology that creates measurable business outcomes**
, we'd love to hear from you.

* **Join Sapiogen AI and help us build the future of AI-first software engineering.**

title: Senior NetSuite Integration Architect
description:
**About the Company:**

Relay Human Cloud is a young & dynamic company that helps some of the top US-based companies to expand their team internationally. Relay is a truly global company having its operations in US, India, Honduras, and Mexico (We are also adding a few more countries soon). Our core focus is to enable companies to connect with the best international talent. Relay helps its clients in majorly following areas: Accounting & Finance, Administration, Operations, Space Planning, Leasing, Data Science, Data Search, Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence etc. Relay India operates from Ahmedabad and Vadodara offices. The principals and founders of Relay Human Cloud have been focused on delivering high-quality operations in cutting-edge companies for their entire careers.

**Job Summary:**

We are seeking a hands-on Senior Manager – Enterprise Integration & Data Architecture with strong NetSuite integration expertise to design, develop, and maintain enterprise integrations, APIs, EDI, and data pipelines. The ideal candidate will have strong technical skills and a solid understanding of distribution, inventory, order processing, and accounting workflows. This role focuses on hands-on implementation, troubleshooting, and long-term technical ownership rather than project management.

**Responsibilities:**

**Enterprise integration architecture**

* Design and maintain the company's enterprise integration architecture, including approved patterns for APIs, EDI, webhooks, SFTP, files, native connectors, events, and batch processing.
* Define source and target systems, authoritative data boundaries, field mappings, timing, sequencing, validation, error handling, retry, reconciliation, security, and support ownership for each interface.
* Avoid uncontrolled point-to-point connections, duplicated business logic, and integrations that create parallel systems of record.
* Maintain architecture diagrams, interface inventories, mapping specifications, decision records, and runbooks while determining which existing interfaces should be retained, redesigned, replaced, or retired.

**NetSuite integration engineering**

* Design, build, test, deploy, and support integrations between NetSuite and internal or external systems.
* Develop deep knowledge of the NetSuite record, transaction, permission, and posting models so interfaces create valid operational and accounting results.
* Work with applicable NetSuite capabilities such as REST web services, SuiteTalk, RESTlets, SuiteScript, SuiteQL, SuiteAnalytics Connect, web services, and token-based authentication.
* Use Oracle integration technologies where appropriate, establish reusable engineering patterns, and challenge partner-proposed designs before owning the deployed solution and support model.

**Customer vendor and external ecosystem integration**

* Support EDI and API connectivity for customers, broadline distributors, vendors, logistics providers, marketplaces, payment services, websites, and other business partners.
* Design mappings and workflows for relevant documents such as purchase orders, acknowledgments, advance ship notices, invoices, inventory updates, item data, pricing, and order status.
* Support vendor onboarding, customer enablement, item synchronization, pricing exchange, order ingestion, fulfillment status, and other digital transaction flows while keeping partner-specific rules documented and controlled.
* Build repeatable onboarding patterns that reduce the cost and time required to connect new customers, vendors, and acquisitions.

**Data architecture ownership and governance**

* Help define company's enterprise data architecture with NetSuite as the authoritative transactional platform for the processes it owns.
* Establish clear boundaries for transactional, master, analytical, historical, reference, and external application data.
* Partner with business and application owners to define authoritative sources, data ownership, approval rights, stewardship, quality rules, and lifecycle requirements.
* Design governed data pipelines, transformation logic, shared definitions, and reconciliations so critical item, pricing, costing, inventory, margin, customer, vendor, and financial logic remains transparent and auditable.

**Legacy discovery migration and transition**

* Inspect legacy applications, databases, scripts, interfaces, files, and automated jobs to identify embedded business rules and technical dependencies.
* Document why existing functionality exists before replacing it, separating requirements that must be preserved from obsolete workarounds and technical debt.
* Support extraction, transformation, mapping, cleansing, conversion, validation, and reconciliation with repeatable utilities and control totals that preserve financial, operational, and referential integrity.
* Plan retirement, archival, access, and support arrangements for legacy data and applications that will not move into the future environment.

**Analytics data services and application enablement**

* Support the architecture and ongoing operation of NetSuite Analytics Warehouse and related analytics capabilities where adopted.
* Define the appropriate roles of NetSuite native reporting, governed analytical platforms, Power BI, and other reporting tools so business logic is not recreated inconsistently.
* Design data models and pipelines that provide trusted reporting and reconcile to source transactions.
* Support approved extension platforms for internal tools, portals, and workflows, and enable automation or AI only through governed data, controlled interfaces, clear ownership, and appropriate human review.

**Testing monitoring security and operational support**

* Develop and execute unit, integration, end-to-end, performance, failure-mode, cutover, and reconciliation testing with documented acceptance criteria.
* Implement logging, automated alerts, transaction tracing, exception queues, retry mechanisms, dashboards, and escalation procedures so failures are visible and actionable.
* Perform hands-on production troubleshooting and root-cause analysis across systems, data, network, authentication, mapping, sequencing, and business-rule layers.
* Apply secure access and data protection while establishing standards for source control, code review, automated testing, environment separation, deployment, versioning, rollback, documentation, and change control.

**Long term architecture ownership**

* Become a primary internal owner for enterprise integrations, data pipelines, interface standards, and supporting technical documentation.
* Work side by side with implementation-partner engineers during design and build activities rather than receiving knowledge only at the end of the program.
* Build internal support capability, reduce unnecessary dependence on external consultants, and prioritize technical debt and enhancements based on business value, reliability, control risk, total cost, and operational impact.
* Create scalable patterns that support growth, acquisition integration, customer and vendor enablement, analytics, automation, and future digital services

**Qualifications:**

* More than 7 years of enterprise application integration, software engineering, data engineering, or related technical experience.
* Meaningful hands-on experience integrating with NetSuite and working with its records, transactions, permissions, APIs, or scripting capabilities.
* Strong knowledge of REST and SOAP services, JSON, XML, SQL, SFTP, webhooks, authentication, and modern integration patterns.
* Experience designing, building, testing, deploying, monitoring, and supporting production integrations and data pipelines.
* Experience with data mapping, transformation, migration, reconciliation, master data, and data-quality controls.
* Strong troubleshooting and root-cause-analysis skills across applications, interfaces, data, security, and business processes.
* Experience with API security, token-based authentication, source control, code review, testing, deployment, environment management, and operational documentation.
* Ability to understand order-to-cash, procure-to-pay, inventory, fulfillment, and accounting impacts in addition to technical specifications.
* Ability to evaluate and challenge consultant or vendor recommendations and assume ownership of the resulting design.
* Strong written communication and willingness to remain hands-on throughout implementation and long-term operation of the environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), NetSuite Integration Platform, and other Oracle integration technologies.
* Experience with SuiteTalk, SuiteScript, RESTlets, SuiteQL, SuiteAnalytics Connect, or NetSuite Analytics Warehouse.
* Knowledge of EDI standards and third-party integration processes.
* Experience in food distribution, wholesale distribution, retail, logistics, or other transaction-intensive industries.
* Experience modernizing Microsoft Dynamics GP or custom legacy applications.
* Familiarity with Oracle APEX, Power BI, cloud data platforms, workflow automation, or document processing.
* Experience with multi-entity environments, acquisitions, and high-volume order and inventory transactions.

**Why Join Relay Human Cloud? ✨**

🌍 Opportunities to work with global clients

🤝 Dynamic and collaborative work environment

⚖️ Excellent work-life balance – 5-day workweek

🩺 Comprehensive health & accident insurance

🌴 Generous paid time off and holidays

🍽️ Complimentary lunches & dinners

🏆 Quarterly, Semi-Annual & Annual recognition, rewards, and giveaways

📚 Employee development programs – Communication, Soft Skills, and more

🎉 Vibrant cultural events – Fun Fridays, Month-End Celebrations, Sports Tournaments, and Festival celebrations

🎯 Excellent Employee Referral Program

title: Software Engineering Manager
description:

Software Engineering Manager
  
  
**Department:**
Technology
  
  
**Reports to:**
CTO
  
  
**Experience:**
8+ years
  
  
**Location:**
Ahmedabad, India (Remote option Available)
  
  
**Company Introduction**
Genea was built on a foundation of listening to and serving our commercial real estate customer’s needs starting with our flagship Overtime HVAC product. Over the years, we’ve earned the trust and loyalty of 21 of the top 25 largest commercial real estate companies in the US and continue to prove our value to them every day. Our clients depend on us to develop value-added technology solutions to solve other pain points in their operations. We have grown our product portfolio to serve the complex and expanding needs of property teams.
  
  
Genea is a family of solutions are designed to improve commercial real estate operations through cutting-edge technology. Revolutionize access control, streamline overtime HVAC, and economize submeter billing. Our host of cloud-based, automated solutions are built to cut costs, reduce admin times, and maximize the tenant experience.
  
  
Experiencing enormous growth with aggressive expansion plans, Genea is expanding a Software Development and Operations center in India and is looking for dynamic engineering leaders, who can become part of this already successful growth story, and partner in creating a world class team and products.
  
  
We are fully remote since pre-COVID times. We're US-based, with a development centre in Ahmedabad, India.
  
  
**Job Overview**
Genea is looking for a Engineering Lead to help grow our development team. You will participate in the full SDLC from preliminary system analysis to testing and deployment. This hybrid-engineering role includes building high quality and fully performing software that meets quality and software development standards alongside a great team.
  
  
**What you would do, day-to-day?**

* Drive team efforts
* Have a keen eye on code quality with code scalability, maintainability, readability in mind
* Have a solution-oriented mindset and high load capacity system in mind
* Estimate work, delegate work
* Manage the people on a large engineering team to keep them aligned and focused on achieving the team’s goals
* Drives the design, strategy, and execution of software development projects to support product roadmaps
* Lead technology architecture and development as per product needs
* Oversee the daily activities and progress of multiple SCRUM teams
* Monitor, and continuously update, team metrics for measurement of engineering and operational excellence. Ensure a consistent, regular process for assessment of goals and improvement of deliveries
* Lead many SCRUM teams through estimating engineering effort to build new features and fix prior mistakes
* Collaborate with Product Managers on new products and new features
* Implement data driven approach to execution to drive transparency

**What are we looking for?**

* 8+ years of total experience and 3+ years of relevant work experience as team lead
* Experience in microservice and event driven architecture
* Proficient in backend technologies, preferably JavaScript, but we’re open to other technologies
* Proficient in frontend technologies, preferably React, but we’re open to any other JavaScript - based frameworks like Angular, Vue, etc
* Proficient in database technologies like MongoDB or RDBMS (We use PostgreSQL)
* Excellent understanding of software development life cycles (SDLC) with experience guiding teams through planning, development, and rollout using best in industry agile practices
* Having experience in work estimation and delegation is preferable
* Understanding of testing practices like writing unit/integration test cases
* Strong Articulation skills - Ability to write/explain complex problems over email or call
* Obsession for excellence - Should strive for being excellent at work in terms of quality and speed
* Professionalism - Sincere, Integrity, Commitment, Ownership
* Strategic thinker with the ability to formulate product and business strategies
* Prior experience in managing multi-disciplinary teams of manager, senior engineers simultaneously working on multiple projects and technologies
* Strong cross-functional collaboration and influencing skills at high levels
* Possess innate customer service skills including the ability to be empathetic, accurate, compassionate, responsive, resourceful, and conscientious
* Strong relationship management, strategizing, project management, problem solving, and change management skills
* Experience working with AWS is highly preferable. We work with AWS services like EC2, S3, Lambda, CloudWatch, SNS, RDS, SQS.

**How this opportunity is different than other?**

* Opportunity to work directly with the Chief Technology Officer and other Executives
* Opportunity to help create and lead a strong team of engineers and lead innovation and creation of best-in-class products
* Participate in helping shape the contours of the software development and influence outcomes
* Strong participation in engineering strategies and product deliveries
* Opportunity to work with cross geography teams and travel as necessary
* Participate in creating a fun, smart, passionate multi-cultural and merit-driven team
* You will be challenged and encouraged to broaden your and your team’s skills including access to personal development courses and learning platforms
* Regular social & philanthropic events

**Competencies**

* Initiative - Volunteers readily; Undertakes self-development activities; Seeks increased responsibilities; Takes independent actions and calculated risks; Looks for and takes advantage of opportunities; Asks for and offers help when needed.
* Planning/Organizing - Prioritizes and plans work activities; Uses time efficiently; Plans for additional resources; Sets goals and objectives; Organizes or schedules other people and their tasks; Develops realistic action plans.
* Quality - Demonstrates accuracy and thoroughness; Looks for ways to improve and promote quality; Applies feedback to improve performance; Monitors own work to ensure quality.
* Teamwork - Balances team and individual responsibilities; Exhibits objectivity and openness to others' views; Gives and welcomes feedback; Contributes to building a positive team spirit; Puts success of team above own interests; Able to build morale and group commitments to goals and objectives; Supports everyone's efforts to succeed.
* Written Communication - Writes clearly and informatively; Edits work for spelling and grammar; Varies writing style to meet needs; Presents numerical data effectively; Able to read and interpret written information.

**Perks & Benefits**
✨ Work Your Way: Enjoy a flexible working environment that suits your lifestyle.
  
  
✨ Time Off: 24 days of PTO and 10 holidays to unwind and pursue your passions.
  
  
✨ Comprehensive Leave Options: Including maternity, paternity, adoption, wedding, and bereavement leaves to support you during important life events.
  
  
✨ Health & Safety First: Benefit from family health insurance and personal accident coverage beyond your CTC.
  
  
✨ Top Workplace Honors: Celebrated as a Top Workplace from 2021 to 2025.
  
  
✨ Balanced Workweek: Embrace a balanced life with our 5-day work schedule

**Job Description**
Team owns the layer between clients and backend workloads: proxy and L7 services, API Gateway, and inference gateway for AI traffic. Every request to backend services passes through this layer, so latency, availability, and correctness here directly affect everything downstream. You'll build and grow the team, set its technical direction, and own these services end to end, from design through production operations.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Proxy and L7: request routing, TLS termination, connection management, config propagation across a large fleet, and keeping tail latency predictable under load.
* API Gateway: authentication and authorization, rate limiting and quotas, traffic policies, and giving service teams a safe, self-serve way to expose APIs.
* Inference gateway: routing AI inference traffic, which behaves differently from typical web traffic. Requests are long-running and often streamed, cost varies widely by request, and backend GPU capacity is expensive and limited. That makes routing, queuing, fairness, and capacity efficiency hard problems.

**What you'll do:**

* Build and grow the team: hire engineers and tech leads, set expectations, give direct feedback, and develop people over time.

description:
The Head of Enterprise Architecture will act as the custodian of technology architecture for Adani Group, holding end\-to\-end accountability for defining, governing and evolving the Group's technology blueprint across its diversified portfolio of independently operating businesses.
 



 As custodian of architecture across the Group, the role holds the mandate to ensure that technology investments made independently by each business remain strategically aligned, secure, scalable, interoperable, cost\-efficient and designed for reuse. The role chairs the Group Architecture Review Board as the Group's principal governance checkpoint for major technology decisions, and is accountable for the disciplined evaluation of new and emerging technologies before they are adopted at scale.
 



 The role will work closely with Group leadership, Business CDOs/CTOs, the Group CISO and Cyber team, and transformation leaders to evolve the organization from application\-centric technology landscapes toward a platform\-, data\- and API\-driven enterprise architecture.
 



 The role partners closely with the Group's AI Labs, Cloud Engineering and Data organization, aligning their platforms and roadmaps to the wider enterprise architecture, while those functions retain ownership of their respective domains.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 



* Act as the Group's custodian of enterprise architecture: own the Group Enterprise Architecture strategy, principles, standards, reference architectures and the 3–5 year technology roadmap, applied consistently across every Adani Group business.
* Chair the Group Architecture Review Board (ARB) — the central governance body for enterprise technology decisions:
* Set the ARB's review criteria, escalation thresholds and decision rights, ensuring alignment with enterprise standards without slowing day\-to\-day business execution.
* Maintain the ARB as the final sign\-off authority for cross\-business platform, cloud, data and cybersecurity architecture decisions.
* Own the evaluation of new and emerging technologies for the Group:
* Maintain an Enterprise Technology Radar and a documented evaluation framework (business fit, security, cost, interoperability, vendor viability) to assess candidate technologies.
* Systematically move promising technologies — spanning cloud, data platforms, cybersecurity, integration, edge and IoT/OT — from evaluation to proof\-of\-concept, production pilot and Group\-wide adoption.
* Act as the final architectural authority on technology and vendor selection decisions referred to the ARB.
* Establish and lead a federated architecture model that provides Group\-level direction while enabling individual businesses — Ports, Airports, Power, Green Energy, Cement, Gas Distribution and Data Centers — to retain appropriate technology autonomy.
* Drive standardization and reuse of platforms, APIs, data products, integration patterns, cloud foundations, identity, observability and common technology services across all Group businesses.
* Establish architecture principles for hybrid cloud, edge computing, high\-performance compute infrastructure, IoT and industrial/OT environments, reflecting the Group's asset\-intensive businesses.
* Drive technology economics and rationalization across the Group, reducing duplicated platforms, unnecessary licenses, technical debt and long\-term total cost of ownership (TCO).
* Build and lead a high\-calibre central Enterprise Architecture team, and develop a federated architecture community of practice across Adani Group businesses.



**Key Success Measures** 




 Success will be measured through Group\-wide business and technology outcomes, including:
 


* Throughput and turnaround time of decisions reviewed by the Architecture Review Board.
* Proportion of new technologies moved from Technology Radar evaluation through PoC to production and Group\-wide scale.
* Increased reuse and reduced duplication of platforms, data products and technical debt across businesses.
* Improved interoperability between business\-unit systems and Group\-level platforms.
* Lower Group\-wide technology TCO and stronger resilience and cybersecurity posture.
* Consistency of security\-by\-design outcomes, validated jointly with the CISO/Cyber team, across ARB decisions.
* Faster, more consistent technology decision\-making across independently operating businesses.



**Candidate Profile** 




 15–20 years of technology experience, with significant leadership responsibility in large and complex enterprises; prior experience chairing or participating in an enterprise architecture review board or equivalent technology governance forum is highly desirable.
 



 Strong experience across enterprise architecture, technology strategy, cloud and infrastructure, enterprise applications/SAP, data platforms, integration, cybersecurity and emerging technology evaluation. Practical understanding of edge computing and modern platform engineering is highly desirable, along with experience partnering with dedicated Cloud Engineering, Data and AI organizations within a large enterprise.
 



 Experience in diversified, infrastructure\-intensive conglomerates spanning sectors such as ports and logistics, energy and utilities, airports, cement and building materials, or data centers would be directly relevant to the scope of this role.
 



 The candidate must combine deep technical credibility, business and commercial understanding, systems thinking, strong executive communication, and the ability to chair cross\-functional governance forums — working closely with Business CDOs/CTOs, the CISO/Cyber team, and specialist AI, Cloud Engineering and Data organizations — to influence technology decisions across independently operating businesses.

 We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Cloud Engineer to join our Cloud Platform Engineering team responsible for building, securing, automating, and operating a modern multi\-cloud platform.  Shift Timing
